⛳ NEW: RANKED 1v1 on "The Green!" ⚔️

Step up to the starter's booth and get matched with a golfer from ANY server!
🏆 Climb the ranks: Copper, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Champion

🎃 HALLOWEEN AT BEAR WOODS 🦇
-Now through November 1!
The course has gone dark under a full moon. Grab your crew for a TRICK OR TREAT round: every shot could be a treat... or a trick!  Collect the most treats to make the leaderboard. The top 3 win the Blazing Jack-o'-Lantern Driver

🐻 DAB GOLF - Does a Bear Hit in the Woods?

- 9-hole course with up to 8 friends, Casual or Competitive
- Weekly and all-time leaderboards for singles, duos, triples and quads
- TopBear driving range and a putting green to practice
- Drag-back swing on PC, mobile and console
- Earn Bray Bucks for pars, birdies and wins
- Pro Shop: clubs, balls, trails, skins and card themes
- The Green: a night-time par 3 park with 10 bays

👍 Like and favorite to support new updates!
